description: Core Web Vitals report: LCP/INP/CLS per page/strategy this audit already ran Lighthouse against, classified against Google's own published thresholds. No new fetch — reads audit_lighthouse_results, the same table the results UI already renders as raw numbers. LAB DATA ONLY, never Search Console's real Chrome UX Report (CrUX) field data — every number is a single simulated Lighthouse run, not an aggregated real-user measurement. This codebase's audit pipeline runs local headless Chrome as its PRIMARY path, so CrUX field data is not reliably available for any given page. ALWAYS narrow on `state` first: `no_lighthouse_data` (this audit has no Lighthouse rows at all — an absence of data, NOT every page passing) or `analysed`. Errors when no audit with that id belongs to the project. `pages[].allGood` is true only when all three metrics were measured AND all three are "good". Free — charges no credits.

auditId.description: Audit ID, from crawl_site or get_crawl_results.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: get_audit_core_web_vitals
